name: agentarmy-infisical
description: Infisical (ARC-ADR-037) — the BYO-credentials secrets STORE. Platform tier (ARC-ADR-023): users register their per-system keys here; backend-core's broker layer keeps raw keys server-side and hands tools scoped/short-lived references. Self-hosted as the Infisical backend + Postgres + Redis. Chosen over Vault (BSL) / OpenBao (heavier ops) for fastest adoption at the current solo/trusted stage, with a documented upgrade path to OpenBao for untrusted multi-tenancy.

secrets.name: encryption_key
secrets.description: Infisical data-encryption key (32 hex). Rolled by setup.sh into the gitignored .env — never committed.

secrets.name: auth_secret
secrets.description: Infisical JWT/auth secret (base64). Rolled by setup.sh.

secrets.name: postgres_password
secrets.description: Infisical Postgres password. Rolled by setup.sh.

shims.note: Pulls upstream images (infisical/infisical:v0.160.7, postgres:14-alpine, redis:7-alpine) — nothing built. setup.sh generates the gitignored .env (secrets + DB/Redis URIs + SITE_URL); the backend runs DB migrations on first boot.

doctor.description: GET http://localhost:8333/api/status returns 200 — the Infisical backend is up, migrated, and reachable behind Postgres + Redis.

deploy.notes: Platform tier. Locally via setup.sh (docker compose). On ACA: run the backend as a container app backed by Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server + Azure Cache for Redis, secrets from Key Vault, fronted by CF Access. Only backend-core's broker talks to it; tools never reach it directly.

contract.note: The secrets store behind the BYO-credentials broker. backend-core's /api/v1/credentials/* layer is its only client; it keeps raw keys server-side and issues tools scoped references.
